    20	// one shared wind clock for every plant in the world
    21	export const WIND = {
    22	  time: { value: 0 },
    23	  dir: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.76, 0.48).normalize() },
    24	  strength: { value: 0.55 },
    25	};
    26	
    27	// Hierarchical wind (LAAS Wind.ts): per-branch flex/phase in the aWind
    28	// attribute, gust fronts travelling along the wind direction drive amplitude,
    29	// a second axis at ×1.31 draws Lissajous ellipses, cards get a fine flutter.
    30	export function windifyVeg(material) {
    31	  material.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    32	    sh.uniforms.uWindT = WIND.time;
    33	    sh.uniforms.uWindD = WIND.dir;
    34	    sh.uniforms.uWindS = WIND.strength;
    35	    sh.vertexShader =
    36	      'uniform float uWindT; uniform vec2 uWindD; uniform float uWindS; attribute vec2 aWind;\n' +
    37	      sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>', `
    38	      #include <begin_vertex>
    39	      {
    40	        vec3 iPos = vec3(0.0);
    41	        #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
    42	        iPos = vec3(instanceMatrix[3][0], instanceMatrix[3][1], instanceMatrix[3][2]);
    43	        #endif
    44	        float phase = aWind.y + fract(sin(dot(iPos.xz, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453) * 6.2831;
    45	        float gust = 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(dot(iPos.xz, uWindD) * 0.02 - uWindT * 1.35 + phase * 0.13);
    46	        float f1 = 0.9 + fract(phase * 1.7) * 0.7;
    47	        float hK = min(transformed.y * 0.09, 1.2);
    48	        float lean = uWindS * uWindS * 0.35;
    49	        float swayA = sin(uWindT * f1 + phase) * gust * uWindS;
    50	        float swayB = sin(uWindT * f1 * 1.31 + phase * 1.7) * gust * uWindS;
    51	        vec2 disp = uWindD * (lean + 0.32 * swayA) + vec2(-uWindD.y, uWindD.x) * 0.16 * swayB;
    52	        transformed.xz += disp * aWind.x * hK;
    53	        transformed += normal * (sin(uWindT * 4.7 + phase + transformed.x * 3.1)
    54	          * 0.02 * aWind.x * uWindS);
    55	      }
    56	      `);
    57	  };
    58	  return material;
    59	}

    61	// legacy vertex-colour wind (still used by the reeds and small props)
    62	export function windify(material) {
    63	  material.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    64	    sh.uniforms.uWindT = WIND.time;
    65	    sh.uniforms.uWindD = WIND.dir;
    66	    sh.uniforms.uWindS = WIND.strength;
    67	    sh.vertexShader = 'uniform float uWindT; uniform vec2 uWindD; uniform float uWindS;\n' +
    68	      sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>', `
    69	      #include <begin_vertex>
    70	      #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
    71	      {
    72	        vec3 iPos = vec3(instanceMatrix[3][0], instanceMatrix[3][1], instanceMatrix[3][2]);
    73	        float phase = fract(sin(dot(iPos.xz, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453) * 6.2831;
    74	        float flex = clamp((vColor.g - vColor.r) * 2.2, 0.0, 1.0) * transformed.y * transformed.y;
    75	        float gust = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(dot(iPos.xz, uWindD) * 0.018 - uWindT * 1.25 + phase * 0.31);
    76	        float f = 1.0 + fract(phase * 2.7) * 1.6;
    77	        float lean = uWindS * uWindS * 0.5;
    78	        float swayA = sin(uWindT * f + phase) * gust * uWindS;
    79	        float swayB = sin(uWindT * f * 1.31 + phase * 1.7) * gust * uWindS;
    80	        vec2 disp = uWindD * (lean + 0.24 * swayA) + vec2(-uWindD.y, uWindD.x) * 0.12 * swayB;
    81	        transformed.xz += disp * flex;
    82	      }
    83	      #endif
    84	      `);
    85	  };
    86	  return material;
    87	}

    31	function bucketAdd(m, p) {
    32	  const k = Math.floor(p[0] / BK_W) * 8192 + Math.floor(p[1] / BK_W);
    33	  if (!m.has(k)) m.set(k, []);
    34	  m.get(k).push(p);
    35	}
    36	function bucketDist(m, x, z) {
    37	  const bx = Math.floor(x / BK_W), bz = Math.floor(z / BK_W);
    38	  let best = Infinity;
    39	  for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
    40	    const arr = m.get((bx + dx) * 8192 + (bz + dz));
    41	    if (!arr) continue;
    42	    for (const p of arr) {
    43	      const d = (p[0] - x) * (p[0] - x) + (p[1] - z) * (p[1] - z);
    44	      if (d < best) best = d;
    45	    }
    46	  }
    47	  return Math.sqrt(best);   // Infinity → caller keeps the coarse value
    48	}

    99	function wdSample(arr, x, z) {
   100	  const fx = clamp((x - (HM_OFF_X - HM_SPAN / 2)) / WD_RES, 0, WD_N - 1.001);
   101	  const fz = clamp((z - (HM_OFF_Z - HM_SPAN / 2)) / WD_RES, 0, WD_N - 1.001);
   102	  const x0 = Math.floor(fx), z0 = Math.floor(fz);

   357	export function fieldAt(era, x, z) {
   358	  const { fields, map } = fieldsIndexed(era);
   359	  const arr = map.get(Math.floor(x / FIELD_CELL) + ':' + Math.floor(z / FIELD_CELL));
   360	  if (!arr) return null;
   361	  for (const i of arr) {
   362	    const f = fields[i];
   363	    const dx = x - f.cx, dz = z - f.cz;
   364	    const c = Math.cos(-f.rot), s = Math.sin(-f.rot);
   365	    const u = (dx * c - dz * s) / f.rx, v = (dx * s + dz * c) / f.rz;
   366	    const d = u * u + v * v;
   367	    if (d < 1) return { field: f, edge: 1 - d };
   368	  }
   369	  return null;

   444	export function distToRoadEx(era, x, z) {
   445	  if (era <= 1) return { d: Infinity, c: 2 };
   446	  const { segs, map } = roadGridFor(era);
   447	  const cix = Math.floor(x / ROAD_CELL), ciz = Math.floor(z / ROAD_CELL);
   448	  let bd = Infinity, bc = 2;
   449	  for (let ix = cix - 1; ix <= cix + 1; ix++) {
   450	    for (let iz = ciz - 1; iz <= ciz + 1; iz++) {
   451	      const arr = map.get(ix + ':' + iz);
   452	      if (!arr) continue;
   453	      for (const si of arr) {
   454	        const s = segs[si];
   455	        const vx = s[2] - s[0], vz = s[3] - s[1];
   456	        const L = vx * vx + vz * vz;
   457	        const t = L ? clamp(((x - s[0]) * vx + (z - s[1]) * vz) / L, 0, 1) : 0;
   458	        const d = Math.hypot(x - (s[0] + vx * t), z - (s[1] + vz * t)) - s[4];
   459	        if (d < bd) { bd = d; bc = s[5]; }
   460	      }
   461	    }
   462	  }
   463	  return { d: bd, c: bc };
   464	}
   465	export function distToRoad(era, x, z) {
   466	  return distToRoadEx(era, x, z).d;
   467	}

   249	function detailify(material, strength) {

   284	// exact height of the RENDERED terrain surface (the mesh's own triangles).
   285	// heightAt() is the smooth field; between the 17m mesh vertices the two can

   287	let meshH = null;
   288	export function meshHeightAt(x, z) {
   289	  if (!meshH) return heightAt(x, z);
   290	  const { arr, x0, z0, sx, sz, n } = meshH;
   291	  // signed steps: after rotateX(-PI/2) the vertex rows run in DECREASING z
   292	  const fx = clamp((x - x0) / sx, 0, n - 1.001);
   293	  const fz = clamp((z - z0) / sz, 0, n - 1.001);
   294	  const c = Math.floor(fx), r = Math.floor(fz);
   295	  const u = fx - c, v = fz - r;
   296	  const hA = arr[r * n + c], hB = arr[r * n + c + 1];
   297	  const hC = arr[(r + 1) * n + c], hD = arr[(r + 1) * n + c + 1];
   298	  // PlaneGeometry splits each cell A-B / C-D along the B-C diagonal
   299	  if (u + v <= 1) return hA + (hB - hA) * u + (hC - hA) * v;
   300	  return hD + (hC - hD) * (1 - u) + (hB - hD) * (1 - v);
   301	}

     4	export function mulberry32(seed) {
     5	  let a = seed >>> 0;
     6	  return function () {
     7	    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
     8	    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
     9	    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    10	    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    11	  };
    12	}
    13	
    14	export const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
    15	export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
    16	export const smoothstep = (a, b, v) => {
    17	  const t = clamp((v - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
    18	  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    19	};

    21	// Deterministic 2D value noise with fbm
    22	export function makeNoise(seed = 1) {
    23	  const rng = mulberry32(seed);
    24	  const P = 256, perm = new Uint8Array(P * 2), vals = new Float32Array(P);
    25	  for (let i = 0; i < P; i++) { perm[i] = i; vals[i] = rng(); }
    26	  for (let i = P - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = (rng() * (i + 1)) | 0; [perm[i], perm[j]] = [perm[j], perm[i]]; }
    27	  for (let i = 0; i < P; i++) perm[P + i] = perm[i];
    28	  const at = (xi, yi) => vals[perm[perm[xi & 255] + (yi & 255)]];
    29	  function noise2(x, y) {
    30	    const xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y);
    31	    const xf = x - xi, yf = y - yi;
    32	    const u = xf * xf * (3 - 2 * xf), v = yf * yf * (3 - 2 * yf);
    33	    return lerp(lerp(at(xi, yi), at(xi + 1, yi), u), lerp(at(xi, yi + 1), at(xi + 1, yi + 1), u), v);
    34	  }
    35	  function fbm(x, y, oct = 4, lac = 2, gain = 0.5) {
    36	    let f = 0, amp = 0.5, fr = 1;
    37	    for (let i = 0; i < oct; i++) { f += amp * noise2(x * fr, y * fr); fr *= lac; amp *= gain; }
    38	    return f;
    39	  }
    40	  return { noise2, fbm, rng };
    41	}

    55	// Catmull-Rom sample over an array of [x, z(, y)] points, t in [0,1]
    56	export function sampleSpline(pts, t) {
    57	  const n = pts.length - 1;
    58	  const f = clamp(t, 0, 0.99999) * n;
    59	  const i = Math.floor(f), u = f - i;
    60	  const p = (k) => pts[clamp(k, 0, n)];
    61	  const c = (a, b, cc, d, uu) =>
    62	    0.5 * ((2 * b) + (-a + cc) * uu + (2 * a - 5 * b + 4 * cc - d) * uu * uu + (-a + 3 * b - 3 * cc + d) * uu * uu * uu);
    63	  const out = [];
    64	  for (let k = 0; k < p(0).length; k++) out[k] = c(p(i - 1)[k], p(i)[k], p(i + 1)[k], p(i + 2)[k], u);
    65	  return out;
    66	}
    67	
    68	// Arc-length-even spline sampling. sampleSpline's parameter is uniform per
    69	// SEGMENT, so "N samples" cluster where source points cluster and leave
    70	// 25-80m gaps across long segments — every consumer that stamped, splatted
    71	// or measured along "fine" samples inherited those gaps.
    72	export function sampleSplineEven(pts, step) {
    73	  const N = Math.min(60000, pts.length * 40);
    74	  let prev = sampleSpline(pts, 0), acc = 0;
    75	  const out = [prev];
    76	  for (let i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
    77	    const p = sampleSpline(pts, i / N);
    78	    acc += Math.hypot(p[0] - prev[0], p[1] - prev[1]);
    79	    prev = p;
    80	    if (acc >= step) { out.push(p); acc = 0; }
    81	  }
    82	  out.push(prev);
    83	  return out;
    84	}

    86	export function pointInPoly(x, z, poly) {
    87	  let inside = false;
    88	  for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {
    89	    const [xi, zi] = poly[i], [xj, zj] = poly[j];
    90	    if ((zi > z) !== (zj > z) && x < ((xj - xi) * (z - zi)) / (zj - zi) + xi) inside = !inside;
    91	  }
    92	  return inside;
    93	}

    95	export function distToPolyline(x, z, pts) {
    96	  let bd = Infinity;
    97	  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    98	    const ax = pts[i][0], az = pts[i][1], bx = pts[i + 1][0], bz = pts[i + 1][1];
    99	    const vx = bx - ax, vz = bz - az;
   100	    const L = vx * vx + vz * vz;
   101	    const t = L ? clamp(((x - ax) * vx + (z - az) * vz) / L, 0, 1) : 0;
   102	    const d = Math.hypot(x - (ax + vx * t), z - (az + vz * t));
   103	    if (d < bd) bd = d;
   104	  }
   105	  return bd;
   106	}
   107	
   108	export function splineLength(pts, samples = 200) {
   109	  let len = 0, prev = sampleSpline(pts, 0);
   110	  for (let i = 1; i <= samples; i++) {
   111	    const cur = sampleSpline(pts, i / samples);
   112	    len += Math.hypot(cur[0] - prev[0], cur[1] - prev[1]);
   113	    prev = cur;
   114	  }
   115	  return len;
   116	}

   470	export function forestDensity(era, x, z, y) {
   471	  if (era === 0) {
   472	    // Younger Dryas tundra: no forest — dwarf-birch / juniper shrub heath

    58	// Water ribbon, LAAS-shore rules: high tessellation so bends are CURVES
    59	// (the old 63m segments read as rectangles), and a FLAT surface — the
    60	// shoreline comes from the carved bank rising through the plane.
    61	function ribbon(pts, widthFn, mat, uvScale = 60, edgeDrop = 0.85) {
    62	  // SEG and the tangent window MUST match the bank skirt exactly — the
    63	  // skirt's inner verts are meant to be vertex-for-vertex identical with
    64	  // these edges; any tessellation drift opens black slivers into the trench
    65	  const SEG = Math.min(2000, pts.length * 6);
    66	  // LAAS shore rule: the water surface is FLAT (a sloped surface reads as a
    67	  // convex hump from the bank) — only a slight edge tuck hides the seam.
    68	  // The shoreline itself comes from the bank rising THROUGH the plane, so
    69	  // the spline-following channel carve must clear the full ribbon width.
    70	  const EDGE_DROP = edgeDrop;
    71	  // 5 verts per row: the surface stays DEAD FLAT out to ~96% width, then a
    72	  // short near-vertical rim drops under the bank collar. A gradual slope
    73	  // read as a dark tilted band along every shore at grazing angles.
    74	  const positions = [], uvs = [], indices = [];
    75	  for (let i = 0; i <= SEG; i++) {
    76	    const t = i / SEG;
    77	    const [x, z, y] = sampleSpline(pts, t);
    78	    const [xa, za] = sampleSpline(pts, Math.max(0, t - 0.004));
    79	    const [x2, z2] = sampleSpline(pts, Math.min(1, t + 0.004));
    80	    let dx = x2 - xa, dz = z2 - za;
    81	    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    82	    dx /= len; dz /= len;
    83	    const w = widthFn(t) + 1.6; // overshoot into the banks
    84	    const wf = w - 0.5;         // flat out to here
    85	    positions.push(
    86	      x - dz * w, y - EDGE_DROP, z + dx * w,
    87	      x - dz * wf, y, z + dx * wf,
    88	      x, y, z,
    89	      x + dz * wf, y, z - dx * wf,
    90	      x + dz * w, y - EDGE_DROP, z - dx * w);
    91	    uvs.push(0, t * uvScale, 0.04, t * uvScale, 0.5, t * uvScale, 0.96, t * uvScale, 1, t * uvScale);
    92	    if (i < SEG) {
    93	      const a = i * 5;
    94	      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    95	        indices.push(a + k, a + k + 1, a + k + 6, a + k, a + k + 6, a + k + 5);
    96	      }
    97	    }
    98	  }
    99	  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
   100	  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
   101	  geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
   102	  geo.setIndex(indices);
   103	  geo.computeVertexNormals();
   104	  return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
   105	}

}
